name: eventhub-monorepo
description: EventHub Smart Campus Event Management System

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const fe = spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev', '--prefix', 'frontend'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); const be = spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev', '--prefix', 'backend'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); process.on('SIGINT', () => { fe.kill(); be.kill(); process.exit(); });"

author: Byte Busters
